Temporal endpoint-feature rates are not spatial reward gradients. Inherit the predictive-flow relative RMS dose 0.33, neutral ramp factor, seven bounded backtracking attempts, 0.15 A maximum atom step and 6 A cumulative RMS cap. Multiplying the entire reward need not raise a normalized dose. Dose alternatives in discovery are nonmonotonic and do not justify escalation from weak association alone. Use zero extra production forward calls, no affinity-head gradient, SMC or graph veto. Validation hypotheses: fresh batches paired with native generation will maintain or improve final mean predicted affinity after predeclared handling of all attempts, failures and missing labels; strain median and p90 will satisfy a predeclared material-regression margin against the paired native baseline; logged actual displacement, clipping and backtracking will show whether guidance is delivered within support without unacceptable physical tails. Neither that margin, the native strain baseline nor paired uncertainty is supplied, so these remain hypotheses, not claimed outcomes.
failure_modes: Adaptive discovery reuse and absent paired uncertainty can make the small mean advantage over programs_3 and _4 disappear on fresh batches. Individual historical parameters are not empirically proven optimal.

The smooth teacher mixture can compromise between incompatible conformations, and detached nearest-teacher or assignment changes can produce discontinuous gradient directions; fixed-frame untyped geometry is not a chemical interaction or energy model.

Regional enrichment can reflect overlapping Gaussian regions or common global shape. Independent field targets and extrapolated temporal fits can impose unsupported geometry or miss observed sign reversals.

Endpoint state preferences do not establish useful parent increments. Sparse ancestry and non-significant corrected survival effects can bias terminal credit; missing future labels must remain missing.

An endpoint VJP can amplify, attenuate or redirect a coordinate attraction. Relative dose normalization, atom clipping and backtracking can reduce actual updates; larger reward scale or RMS ratio need not improve affinity or strain.

Mean affinity, validity, best score and physical tails can move in different directions. No native strain baseline or material-regression margin is supplied, and failure-level affinity handling must be declared before evaluation.

A chemical graph change alone does not demonstrate the mechanism of a quality loss. Graph vetoes, affinity-head gradients, extra production forwards or guidance at unsupported times would violate the execution contract.
